name: ZFP 2 loop Extender PCB
subtitle: Extends the 2 loop ZFP panel to 4 loop
legacyName: ZFP 2 loop Extender PCB (Extends the 2 loop ZFP panel to 4 loop)
family: Analogue Addressable ZFP Networkable Fire Panels
summary: The Z02LOOP/X is an extender 2-Loop PCB that adds two additional loops to the Context Plus ZFP 2 loop panels model Z023040NS/X/CON and model Z025040PS/X/CON. These 2 panels can be expanded to 4 loops by adding the 2-Loop PCB (Part No. Z02LOOP/X), this PCB  provides two additional analogue loop connections (Loop3 & Loop4). Note this PCB is not available for the 1 loop panel version, it is only available for the 2 loop panels to expand them to 4 loops.
description: To install the Z02LOOP/X, simply take this 2-Loop PCB and carefully align its holes up with the four mounting holes on the Main 2-Loop PCB as shown in the diagram below. Then insert the four PCB ‘plug-on’ pillars (supplied with the 2-Loop PCB) through the holes on the 2-Loop PCB and into the holes on the Main 2-Loop PCB. Push the pillars until they click and lock in position.
